title: Parameters let a person choose
summary: A parameter is an input supplied when a job is started. Treat input as data and validate it before using it.
introduction: A parameter is an input supplied when a job is started. Treat input as data and validate it before using it. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain parameters let a person choose
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Parameters let a person choose

blocks.text: The job presents a true-or-false choice. A default does not replace a permission check for sensitive actions.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a clear description for another safe boolean parameter.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Never run arbitrary parameter text as a shell command.
